about: Residual differences between two recordings of real Bazel 9.3.2 that normalisation cannot remove. Format and semantics: scripts/oracle/README.md and AllowList in oracle_compare.py. Every entry's condition is checked on every compare run.

entries.condition: The item is a runfiles manifest action (primary output *.runfiles_manifest or *.runfiles/MANIFEST) and actionKey is the only field that differs.
entries.reason: SourceManifestAction's action key fingerprints the manifest content, which names absolute execroot paths. Every recording has its own workspace copy and output base, so the hash differs; the normalised manifest bytes (outputs surface), argv, inputs and outputs still match.

entries.condition: The item is the buildMetrics event and the only differing fields are the per-SkyFunction evaluated/built/changed/cleaned/dirtied counts (and their list order), the post-invocation Skyframe node count, or the action cache's sizeInBytes.
entries.reason: Skyframe evaluates in parallel, so how many nodes of each SkyFunction are evaluated or dirtied in one invocation varies between identical runs (re2: a few per cent). The serialized action cache size also varies by a few hundred bytes on re2 (161890 vs 161688) with identical actions and outputs. Action, artifact, target, package and per-mnemonic action counts in the same event are still compared.
